objective_for_doctor:

Chief Complaint: pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’m having pain—an intensity of 7 out of 10. It feels tedious, sensitive, tugging, heavy, and sharp. The pain is most clearly located around my right and left ankle, the lateral side of the left foot, and both thighs. It started at a pace of 4 out of 10 and doesn’t radiate anywhere. I also have swelling in areas including my right ankle, left thigh, the dorsal aspects of both feet, and the sole of my left foot.
Can you tell me when this pain and swelling first began and whether it started suddenly or developed gradually?
I don’t know. It started at a pace of 4 out of 10.
When did you first notice the pain and swelling? Was it days ago, weeks ago, or longer?
I don’t know. It started at a pace of 4 out of 10.
Do you have any fever, chills, or other systemic symptoms (such as fatigue, night sweats, or recent weight loss) accompanying the pain and swelling?
I don’t know.
Have you experienced any recent injury, unusual physical activity, or new footwear that might have stressed your ankles, feet, or thighs?
I don’t know. I do take or have recently taken anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and I also take corticosteroids. I also have a history of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and liver cirrhosis.
Are the swollen areas red, warm, or tender to touch, or do they look more like pitting edema without obvious inflammation?
I don’t know.
Do you notice any difference between the left and right sides—such as one leg being more swollen or painful than the other?

Yes—both sides are involved. The pain is in both ankles (right and left) and both thighs (right and left), and the swelling is in the right ankle, the left thigh, the dorsal aspects of both feet, and the sole of the left foot.

I don’t know.

I don’t know.
Have you had any recent periods of prolonged immobility (e.g., long car trips, airplane flights, bed rest) or any new travel that might increase your risk for a blood clot?

I don’t know. But I do have a history of deep vein thrombosis (DVT), and I’m currently taking or have recently taken NSAIDs and corticosteroids. I also have swelling in areas including my right ankle, left thigh, both feet’s dorsal aspects, and the sole of my left foot.
Do you have any tenderness, tightness, or a feeling of heaviness in the calves, especially when you press on them or when you walk?

I don’t know. But I do have swelling in my right ankle and left thigh, and also swelling on the dorsal aspects of both feet and the sole of my left foot. I also have pain in both ankles and both thighs with a heaviness feeling.
